mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_user ( public_id, username, display_name, password_hash, auth_provider, is_active, tenant_key ) VALUES ( UNHEX(REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, 'LOCAL', 1, #{tenantKey} )

mapper.update: UPDATE t_auth_user AS auth_user INNER JOIN t_auth_user_role AS user_role ON user_role.user_id = auth_user.id SET auth_user.auth_version = auth_user.auth_version + 1 WHERE user_role.role_code = #{roleCode} AND (user_role.expires_at IS NULL OR user_role.expires_at > NOW())
